Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The following terms and conditions are specified for the supply of toners: 1. The supplied toner must be completely Brand New, Unu sed, and Original/OEM. Refilled, Recycled, or Compatible toners will not be accep ted. 2. Toners must be fully compatible with the respective pri nter model. 3. tonners must be made available at the office within 15 days from the date of issuance of the Supply Order. 4.An undertaking required from OEM about the genuiness of the product supplied against the bid. 5. tonners will be accepted only after checking their qualit y and specifications. If found different model (Which Is not in the List) non-compliant with the standards, the vendor will b e bound to replace them tonners at their own expense. 6. Payment will be made in accordance with prevailing rul es after the successful supply and satisfactory inspection/ac ceptance of the materials. 7. Any kind of transportation, loading-unloading, and othe r expenses shall be borne by the vendor.

8. The buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease th e quantity as per requirement. The buyer's decision in this re gard shall be final and binding. 9. Manufacturing date of tonner is not older than 6 months. .
